description: ChoreStrike Task Templates v2 — room-type-based, two cleaning levels (putzteufel/putzmuffel). English source text; localized at runtime via IL10N::t(). A template matches a room type when the type is in its roomTypes[] array; house-wide templates belong to the 'household' room type, floor-wide to 'hallway'. levels.putzmuffel === null means the task is omitted from the relaxed plan.

templates.name: Empty dishwasher / do dishes
templates.description: Clear the sink and get the dishes done.
templates.instructions: Check the dishwasher, empty it if clean, and load or hand-wash any dirty dishes. Give the sink a quick wipe.

templates.name: Wipe kitchen counters
templates.description: Clear and wipe down the countertops.
templates.instructions: Move small items aside, spray the counters, and wipe them down. Pay attention to corners and the area behind the sink.

templates.name: Clean kitchen sink
templates.description: Scrub the sink and polish the tap.
templates.instructions: Empty the sink, scrub the basin and drain, and wipe the tap until it shines.

templates.name: Clean stove and cooktop
templates.instructions: Take off the grates, wipe the surface with degreaser, clean the burner caps and control panel, then put everything back.

templates.name: Clean microwave
templates.description: Wipe the microwave inside and out.
templates.instructions: Heat a bowl of water for two minutes to loosen grime, wipe the interior, clean the turntable, and wipe the outside.

templates.name: Mop kitchen floor
templates.description: Sweep and mop the kitchen floor.
templates.instructions: Sweep or vacuum first, then mop with cleaning solution. Watch the corners and under the cabinets.

templates.name: Clean refrigerator
templates.description: Toss expired food and wipe the shelves.
templates.instructions: Remove expired items, take out the removable shelves, wash them, wipe the interior walls, and put everything back tidy.

templates.name: Deep clean oven
templates.description: Scrub the oven inside and out.
templates.instructions: Run a cleaner cycle or scrub with oven cleaner, wipe the racks, and clean the door glass.

templates.name: Clean toilet
templates.description: Scrub the bowl, seat, and outside.
templates.instructions: Apply bowl cleaner, let it sit, scrub with the brush, then wipe the seat and the outside from top to bottom.

templates.name: Clean shower/bathtub
templates.instructions: Apply cleaner to the walls and tub, scrub the grout and tiles, descale the showerhead if needed, rinse thoroughly, and wipe the fixtures.

templates.name: Clean sink and vanity
templates.instructions: Clear the counter, spray the sink and counter, scrub the basin and drain, and polish the tap.

templates.name: Clean mirror
templates.instructions: Spray glass cleaner and wipe the mirror with a lint-free cloth.

templates.name: Clean bathroom floor
templates.description: Sweep and mop the bathroom floor.
templates.instructions: Sweep or vacuum, then mop. Watch the corners and the spot behind the toilet.

templates.name: Deep clean grout and tiles
templates.instructions: Apply grout cleaner, scrub the lines with a small brush, rinse, and wipe the tiles dry.

templates.name: Make the bed
templates.instructions: Smooth the fitted sheet, tuck in the flat sheet, fluff the pillows, and straighten the blanket.

templates.name: Gather bedroom laundry
templates.instructions: Check the hamper, pick up items from floor and chairs, sort roughly, and take them to the laundry area.

templates.name: Dust bedroom surfaces
templates.instructions: Work top to bottom, dust the shelves and decor, and wipe the nightstand and dresser.

templates.name: Vacuum bedroom
templates.instructions: Pick up items from the floor, vacuum under the bed if you can, and use the attachments for edges and corners.

templates.name: Change bed sheets
templates.description: Put fresh sheets on the bed.
templates.instructions: Strip the old sheets and pillowcases, put them in the laundry, and make the bed with fresh bedding.

templates.name: Vacuum living room
templates.instructions: Clear the floor, vacuum under furniture if you can, use the attachments on the upholstery, and move in slow overlapping strokes.

templates.name: Dust living room
templates.instructions: Dust the TV and electronics first, then the shelves and bookcase, and wipe the coffee and side tables.

templates.name: Tidy living room
templates.description: Put everything back in its place.
templates.instructions: Clear surfaces, put away remotes and magazines, plump the cushions, and fold blankets.

templates.name: Tidy toys and games
templates.instructions: Sort toys into their boxes, put away games and books, and clear the floor so you can vacuum.

templates.name: Dust kids room
templates.instructions: Dust the shelves, wipe the desk and window sill, and tidy as you go.

templates.name: Vacuum kids floor
templates.instructions: Pick up toys first, then vacuum or sweep the whole floor, edges included.

templates.name: Clear and wipe desk
templates.description: Clear the desk and wipe it down.
templates.instructions: Tidy papers and cables, wipe the desk surface, and clean the keyboard and monitor.

templates.name: Dust office surfaces
templates.instructions: Dust the shelves, the monitor, and the printer, and wipe the window sill.

templates.name: Empty office trash
templates.description: Empty the bin and add a fresh liner.
templates.instructions: Tie up the bag, take it out, and put in a new liner.

templates.name: Run robot vacuum
templates.description: Let the robot vacuum do the floors.
templates.instructions: Clear cables and loose items off the floor, start the robot vacuum, and empty its bin afterwards.

templates.name: Vacuum hallway and stairs
templates.instructions: Vacuum the hallway floor and the stairs step by step, edges and corners included.

templates.name: Wipe hallway floor
templates.instructions: Sweep first, then mop the hallway floor, paying attention to the entrance area.

templates.name: Tidy hallway and shoes
templates.instructions: Line up shoes, hang up coats, and clear the mail and clutter by the door.

templates.name: Do laundry
templates.description: Wash, dry, and fold a load.
templates.instructions: Sort by color, load the washer, move to the dryer, then fold and put away.

templates.name: Take out all trash
templates.description: Empty the bins around the house.
templates.instructions: Go room to room, empty the small bins, replace the liners, and take everything to the outdoor bins.

templates.name: Sort and take out recycling
templates.description: Empty the recycling and sort it.
templates.instructions: Collect paper, plastic, and glass, sort them into the right bins, and take them out.

templates.name: Sort mail and papers
templates.instructions: Collect all mail and papers, sort into action, file, and recycle, and bin the junk right away.

templates.name: Water houseplants
templates.instructions: Check the soil moisture, water as needed, pick off dead leaves, and rotate the pots for even light.

templates.name: Vacuum all floors
templates.description: Vacuum the floors throughout the house.
templates.instructions: Clear the floors of obstacles, vacuum room by room, and use the attachments for the corners.

templates.name: Dust entire house
templates.instructions: Start with the highest surfaces and work down, hitting every room, and don't forget the ceiling fans and light fixtures.

templates.name: Wipe down appliances
templates.description: Clean the outside of the big appliances.
templates.instructions: Wipe the fridge, dishwasher, and washing machine fronts, and clean the handles and controls.

templates.name: Tidy basement
templates.instructions: Sort boxes, put loose items in bins, label what you keep, and clear a path.

templates.name: Sweep basement floor
templates.description: Sweep out the dust and cobwebs.
templates.instructions: Sweep the floor, knock down cobwebs, and tidy as you go.

templates.name: Weed garden and balcony
templates.instructions: Pull weeds by the root in the beds and on the balcony, and tidy the edges.

templates.name: Water garden plants
templates.instructions: Check the soil, water the beds and balcony plants in the cooler hours, and deadhead the flowers.

templates.name: Sweep patio and balcony
templates.instructions: Sweep the patio or balcony, shake out the mats, and tidy the outdoor furniture.

templates.name: Dust surfaces
templates.description: Dust the surfaces in the room.
templates.instructions: Work top to bottom, dust the shelves and furniture, and wipe the window sill.

templates.name: Vacuum the room
templates.instructions: Clear the floor, vacuum in both directions, and use the attachments for the edges and corners.

templates.name: Tidy and declutter
templates.description: Put the room back in order.
templates.instructions: Clear surfaces, put items in their places, and tidy as you go.
